options.title: Escalation huddles
options.description: Trigger escalation huddles when room-to-physician wait times exceed thresholds. This approach aims to address the slowdown in physician pace and ensure that CTAS 2 patients have immediate access to monitored beds.
options.local_fit: This option leverages existing practices and can be tailored to local context. However, it may require careful calibration of wait-time thresholds to avoid excessive huddles.
options.possible_pressure_transfer: If implemented, pressure could shift from the charge nurse to the physician lead, who would need to attend the huddles and address any identified issues.
options.how_we_would_know: Monitor the frequency of escalation huddles and assess if they effectively address the issue of monitored bed availability for CTAS 2 patients.
options.revisit_or_stop_if: If huddles become too frequent or fail to improve bed availability, consider alternative strategies.

options.title: Protect reserve beds
options.description: Explore the feasibility of protecting a certain number of monitored beds for acute arrivals, particularly CTAS 1 and 2 patients. This strategy aims to address the gap between policy and practice regarding immediate access to monitored beds.
options.local_fit: The effectiveness of this approach may vary based on local bed capacity and occupancy patterns. It may also require coordination with other departments to ensure the availability of reserve beds.
options.possible_pressure_transfer: Pressure may shift from the charge nurse to the physician lead, as they would need to be involved in determining the number and allocation of reserve beds.
options.how_we_would_know: Monitor bed occupancy and the availability of monitored beds for acute arrivals. Assess if the protection of reserve beds improves CTAS 2 patient access.
options.revisit_or_stop_if: If bed protection proves challenging or ineffective, consider alternative methods to ensure immediate access.

recommendation.rationale: Triggering escalation huddles is a feasible initial step, leveraging existing practices and adaptable to local context.
recommendation.would_change_if: If the slowdown in physician pace is primarily due to complex cases or unexpected events, alternative strategies may be needed.
